test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelled sentence.

options.text: The librarian told the childern to return their books by Fryday.
The librarian told the children to return their books by Friday
The libraian told the childrean to return their books by Friday.
The liberian told the childrean to return their boooks by Friday.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "The librarian told the children to return their books by Friday".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"librarian"** means a person who works professionally in a library, managing its operations and helping users find information. (पुस्तकालयाध्यक्ष)

 
 
• **Example:** The librarian helped me locate a rare book about Indian history.
 
 
 
• **"Children"** refers to young individuals below the age of puberty or minors. (बच्चे)
 
 
• **Example:** The children played happily in the park after school.
 
 
 
• **"Friday"** is the fifth day of the week, following Thursday and preceding Saturday. (शुक्रवार)
 
 
• **Example:** We are planning to go on a family trip this Friday.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**
